column1: # Conditional fn-shadow (found by the variation sweep, forward-barrier.tsv:73).
# The branch row graduated to control.tsv §9 (NUR244, 2026-09-26): a
# redefinition in the arm a decided condition skips is a speculative family
# now, placed at its site and resolved live.
# The FN-BODY twin (the thirty-first increment, 2026-09-08): a CAPTURING fn
# value — a factory's returned closure — redefining an outer overloading def
# from inside a fn body outlives the CALL on the interpreter: the same
# drop-then-push leaves the frame's def depth unchanged, so the frame's
# DefCleanup (which pops by depth growth) pops nothing and the replacement
# stays bound after the call, where the analysis restores its snapshot and
# the compiled program kept the outer closure's bake — `g (p 3)` answered
# `1 10` compiled for the interpreter's `1 12`, on the default lane, before
# the compile failure (installDef's same site, FnBodyDepth-gated on a capturing
# value: a capture-free literal takes the compiled bind twin and agrees).
# Full graduation = a runtime binding for the closure's payload that the
# outer read sees after the call.
def kk k:Integer => [z:Integer => [add k z]] end def p (kk 7) end def g fn [[][Integer][def p (kk 9) 1]] end g (p 3)
